text:
maria: Customer report: streaming chat shows duplicated chunks + reordered pieces after quick reconnect (mobile). attached sampleapp log.

oliver: thanks. did they trigger auth refresh during the reconnect?

maria: yes, auth refresh and a proxy in front. looks like proxy replayed a tail buffer.

raj: paste raw SSE excerpt?

maria: snippet:

event: message
data: {"id":"c7","part":1,"body":"Hi th"}

--conn reset--

event: message
data: {"id":"c7","part":2,"body":"ere"}

event: message
data: {"id":"c7","part":2,"body":"ere"}

maria: second part replayed, client applied both -> "Hi thereere" instead of "Hi there".

oliver: which SDKs?

maria: Node sampleapp and Android client both flaky; Go deduped correctly.

raj: probable root causes: (1) client doesn't dedupe by (id, part) tuple; (2) parser splits JSON across SSE boundaries and attempts parse prematurely.

oliver: fix plan: add (id,part) dedupe set + buffer partial SSE data until we can parse valid JSON. TTL to clear stuck buffers. ensure parity tests across SDKs.

maria: sounds good. please add an opt-in sampleapp flag to reproduce locally:

```
# reproduce replay locally
./sampleapp --simulate-replay --seed 99
```

sdk-bot: created task DEVEX-9401: cross-sdk SSE dedupe + buffer tests.

raj: I'll own Node + Android parser changes and unit tests. oliver: can you add the sampleapp harness?

oliver: yep. will add CI job that runs the flaky profile once per PR.

maria: customer update: we'll validate with them after QA pass. thanks team :thumbsup:
